judged_text: The organization slug conditional is inverted by this diff — ...(!IS_TEAM_BILLING_ENABLED && { slug }) became ...(IS_TEAM_BILLING_ENABLED ? { slug } : {}) — so the client-supplied slug is persisted directly to organization.slug precisely when team billing is enabled. On billing-enabled deployments every newly created organization immediately occupies its chosen slug/subdomain while the same create call still writes isOrganizationVerified: false and mirrors the slug into metadata.requestedSlug, so the requestedSlug admin-verification workflow this code previously enforced is bypassed and an unverified (or malicious) org creator squats any unclaimed org slug without waiting for verification.
